prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in Chengdu, I remember we kept talking about how many places there were to eat—felt like the whole city was one giant food map.
Then when I was staying in Suzhou for a bit, the whole home-services thing came up all the time in our building chat—everyone had some recommendation.
Funny enough, that same Chengdu trip also had us comparing rental cars—people kept bringing up different models and where they picked them up.
One meal that really stuck with me was Lao Ma Tou Hotpot—Wu Qian had set it up for 4 of us, and it was on 2025-03-10.
I still remember the details because we showed up right at 11:30, and the contact number on it was 13833445566.
In Suzhou, my neighbor had a home service appointment already done on 2025-03-14 in the afternoon, at Room 1208, Block D, Sunshine Plaza.
And she joked she kept the confirmation screenshot because the phone on it was 13822334455—separately, He Xia had rented a Nissan Sylphy starting 2025-05-21 for 2 days.
